_meta.description: Page ids the reachability check (tests/validate-nav-reachability.js) currently finds unreachable from any menu entry, each with why it is not a regression. Entries may only be REMOVED (a page becomes reachable, or is deleted) or have their reason corrected — never added without the id first appearing as a genuinely new, justified exception. A NEW orphan not listed here fails the gate. Seeded 2026-08-19 against a real `npm ci`-equivalent install (node_modules symlinked into the worktree from the main checkout) — 40 orphans measured, each individually verified against its config/calling component before being listed here (openspec/changes/nav-reachability-gate/tasks.md task 2).

exceptions.KostenpostDetail: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: config.indexRoute names RDSubsidies, but RDSubsidies.config.detailRoute points elsewhere — a grant's cost items have no page-level link back from any reachable page)
exceptions.IPAssetValuationDetail: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: no indexRoute or any other link-field is declared on this page at all, and no component references it)
exceptions.ReconciliationReportDetail: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: config.indexRoute names Reconciliations, but Reconciliations.config.detailRoute points to the bank reconciliation's own detail, not this generated report)
exceptions.ReviewWorkflowDetail: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: config.indexRoute names Jaarrekening, but Jaarrekening.config.detailRoute points to JaarrekeningDetail, not this page)
exceptions.CashflowBufferPolicyDetail: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: config.indexRoute names the menu-reachable CashflowBufferPolicy settings page, but that page's own config declares no field pointing back — it appears to be a superseded duplicate of the reachable CashflowBufferPolicy singleton, same schema)
exceptions.CashflowWeekDetail: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: config.indexRoute names the menu-reachable CashflowDashboard, but that dashboard's widgets are chart/stats-block/alert only — no widget declares a page-navigation field)
exceptions.BookingsForm: IA gap — no menu path; to be resolved by nav-six-clusters (verified: its own route /bookings/calendar/:calendarId/new maps to components/BookingForm.vue, but the actual booking-creation UX renders that same component INLINE inside src/views/bookings/CalendarPage.vue's aside on slot-click — no code path navigates to this page's own route)
exceptions.MobileScannerReceive: verified: opened via <router-link to="/inventory/mobile/receive"> in src/views/inventory/MobileScannerHome.vue, itself menu-reachable at Inventory > Mobile Scanner — a real entry point the config-field reachability relation does not model (bespoke component, not a manifest link field)
exceptions.MobileScannerTransfer: verified: opened via <router-link to="/inventory/mobile/transfer"> in src/views/inventory/MobileScannerHome.vue, itself menu-reachable at Inventory > Mobile Scanner
exceptions.MobileScannerPick: verified: opened via <router-link to="/inventory/mobile/pick"> in src/views/inventory/MobileScannerHome.vue, itself menu-reachable at Inventory > Mobile Scanner
exceptions.MobileScannerCount: verified: opened via <router-link to="/inventory/mobile/count"> in src/views/inventory/MobileScannerHome.vue, itself menu-reachable at Inventory > Mobile Scanner
exceptions.BookingsCalendarView: verified intentional deep-link-only route: src/views/bookings/CalendarPage.vue's own header comment documents that the /verkoop/boekingen-kalender nav entry was deliberately removed under shillinq-manifest-boot-payload-reduction REQ-MBP-002, and /bookings/calendar/:calendarId is meant to be reached by direct/external URL (calendarId route param), not app navigation, by design
exceptions.BookingsConfirmationPortal: verified: src/views/bookings/ConfirmationPortal.vue's own header comment confirms it is "Mounted by the v2 manifest at /confirm/:appointmentId so a customer can" confirm their appointment — a customer-facing link sent outside the app (e.g. email), not part of app navigation
exceptions.VendorPerformanceDetail: verified: row click via :to="{ name: 'VendorPerformanceDetail', params: { id: row.id } }" in src/components/vendor-performance/VendorPerformanceIndex.vue, itself menu-reachable at Purchase Orders > Vendor performance — a bespoke component's named-route link, not the manifest's declarative rowRoute field
exceptions.GoodsReceiptNoteDetail: verified: opened via named-route push (name: 'GoodsReceiptNoteDetail') from src/components/purchase-order/PurchaseOrderDetail.vue (menu-reachable) and from src/components/goods-receipt-note/GoodsReceiptNoteForm.vue's post-submit redirect (that form is itself menu-reachable at Purchasing > Goods Receipt Notes > Receive goods) — bespoke component navigation, not the manifest's declarative detailRoute/rowRoute fields
exceptions.BudgetMappingDetail: verified: row click and "Add" both use this.$router.push({...}) in src/components/BudgetBBVMapping/BudgetBBVMappingIndex.vue (component of page id BudgetBBVMappings, itself menu-reachable at the top level) — bespoke component navigation, not the manifest's declarative rowRoute field
exceptions.BillableInvoiceDetail: verified: <router-link :to="`/invoice/${row.id}`"> in src/views/invoice/AdminInvoiceList.vue (page id BillableInvoiceList, itself menu-reachable at Invoices > All invoices) — bespoke component navigation, not the manifest's declarative rowRoute field
exceptions.GeneratedReportsIndex: verified: :to="{ name: 'GeneratedReportsIndex' }" link in src/components/reporting/ReportingComplianceOverview.vue (itself menu-reachable at the top-level Compliance/ReportingCompliance entry) — a bespoke component's named-route link, not the manifest's declarative viewAllRoute/clickRoute fields
exceptions.CostCenterDetail: nav-six-clusters (design.md §4 row 3, ADR-097 Decision 5 MERGE): the duplicate CostCenters INDEX page (schema AnalyticalDimension, filter dimensionType=cost-center) was deleted and its menu leaf converted to a menu[].query preset on the canonical AnalyticalDimensions page — but AnalyticalDimensions' own detailRoute is AnalyticalDimensionDetail, a different id, so CostCenterDetail (which had richer fields: budget/spentToDate/enterpriseActivity/responsibleUser not on the generic detail) loses its index-driven reachability. Its page/route are NOT deleted (no route renames, ADR-044) — only reachable by direct URL now. A genuine consolidation cost, not a bug.
exceptions.KostenDragerDetail: nav-six-clusters (design.md §4 row 3, ADR-097 Decision 5 MERGE): same cause as CostCenterDetail — the duplicate KostenDragers index (dimensionType=cost-object) was deleted and converted to a preset on the canonical AnalyticalDimensions page, which points row-clicks at AnalyticalDimensionDetail instead. KostenDragerDetail's page/route are untouched, reachable only by direct URL.
exceptions.ConsolidationsDetail: nav-six-clusters (design.md §4 row 11, ADR-097 Decision 5 MERGE): the duplicate Consolidations index (schema ConsolidationGroup) was deleted in favour of the canonical ConsolidationGroups page, which points row-clicks at ConsolidationGroupDetail (a different, non-superset detail page — Consolidations' own detail listed member GroupEntity rows that ConsolidationGroupDetail's ConsolidationPeriod-focused relatedList does not cover). ConsolidationsDetail's page/route are untouched, reachable only by direct URL — not deleted per ADR-044.
exceptions.FlowDetail: Reachable by row click from the Flows index (page id Flows), which is the intended path for a detail page. The link lives in the shared CnFlowsPage component (this.$router.push(`${detailRoute}/${id}`)) rather than a manifest config field, so this static gate cannot see the edge — the same class as the runtime related-object widgets design.md §2 scopes out. NOT an IA gap: verified in a browser on dossiq, where /flows lists flows and clicking one opens /flows/:id. Remove this entry once CnFlowsPage accepts a route NAME in config.detailRoute so the edge becomes declarative (tracked: nextcloud-vue).
